SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    m.recorded_at,
    m.status,
    m.notes,
    p.full_name,
    p.email AS participant_email,
    p.cohort

        MAX(recorded_at) AS max_date

) latest

LEFT JOIN participants p ON m.participant_id = p.participant_id
ORDER BY m.session_id;

INSERT INTO shared_export (export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
SELECT (
  SELECT 'EXP-20261214-001'
), 
  (
    SELECT 'Partner University LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY'
  ),
  json_object(
    'export_date', '2026-12-14',
    'source_database', 'research_db',
    'organization', 'Sleep & Cognition Lab',
    'total_sessions_exported', 27,
    'measurements', (
      SELECT json_group_array(
        json_object(
          'session_id', m.session_id,
          'participant_id', m.participant_id,
          'condition', m.condition,
          'cognitive_score', m.cognitive_score,
          'reaction_ms', m.reaction_ms,
          'recorded_at', m.recorded_at,
          'status', m.status,
          'notes', m.notes,
          'participant', json_object(
            'participant_id', p.participant_id,
            'full_name', p.full_name,
            'email', p.email,
            'cohort', p.cohort,
            'dob', p.dob,
            'phone', p.phone,
            'consent_status', p.consent_status
          )
        )
      ) FROM (
          SELECT 
            m.session_id, 
            m.participant_id, 
            m.condition, 
            m.cognitive_score,
            m.reaction_ms, 
            m.recorded_at, 
            m.status, 
            m.notes
          FROM measurements m
          INNER JOIN (
            SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_date
            FROM measurements
            GROUP BY session_id
          ) sm ON m.session_id = sm.session_id AND m.recorded_at = sm.max_date
        ) m
      JOIN participants p ON m.participant_id = p.participant_id
      ORDER BY m.session_id
    )
  ),
  datetime('now')
